finsights.brief: Has raised its dividend for 3 consecutive years
Suffers from weak gross profit margins

summary: BOC Hong Kong reported 4.9% YoY profit growth to 40.1B HKD; customer deposits surged 7.9% to 2.94T HKD despite 1.03% stock decline to 40.96 HKD
Net interest margin compressed 6 basis points to 1.58% amid rate pressures; ROE held steady at 11.5% with capital ratios strengthening significantly
Asset quality remained robust with impaired loan ratio at 1.14%, outperforming market; total capital ratio rose to 25.98%, CET1 at 24.01%
Final dividend proposed at 1.255 HKD/share; total annual dividend of 2.125 HKD/share represents 6.8% increase, reinforcing shareholder return commitment
Strategic focus on wealth management expansion and digital platform development; executives emphasize AI integration for efficiency amid macro headwinds
